statusLine.command:
input=$(cat); line=$(printf "%s" "$input" | jq -r '[((.session_name // "") as $n | (.session_id // "") as $s | (if ($n|length) > 0 then $n elif ($s|length) > 0 then $s[0:8] else "-" end) as $x | if ($x|length) > 40 then $x[0:39] + "..." else $x end), (.model.display_name // "?"), (.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage // null | if . == null then "" else (round|tostring) end), (.rate_limits.five_hour.resets_at // "" | tostring), (.rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage // null | if . == null then "" else (round|tostring) end), (.rate_limits.seven_day.resets_at // "" | tostring)] | join("\u001f")'); IFS=$(printf "\037") read -r name model f_pct f_rst w_pct w_rst <<EOF
$line
EOF
out="$model"; if [ -n "$f_pct" ] && [ "$f_pct" != "null" ]; then out="$out  |  5h ${f_pct}%"; if [ -n "$f_rst" ] && [ "$f_rst" != "null" ]; then out="$out (resets $(date -d @"$f_rst" "+%-H:%M"))"; fi; fi; if [ -n "$w_pct" ] && [ "$w_pct" != "null" ]; then out="$out  |  7d ${w_pct}%"; if [ -n "$w_rst" ] && [ "$w_rst" != "null" ]; then out="$out (resets $(date -d @"$w_rst" "+%a %-d %b"))"; fi; fi; printf "%s  |  \033[2m%s\033[0m" "$name" "$out"
